meta.name: The Aam Aadmi Family Season 4
meta.description:
This show revolves around a middle-class Sharma family. There's a gossip-loving grandmother, a hardworking father, a sanskaari mom, and two grown up kids who are dealing with their middle-classness in the best way possible.

Rated U/A 7+ · Returning Series · First aired 5 Nov 2016 · India · Language: Hindi · 17 min
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: TVFPlay , ZEE5

videos.title: Jeevan Mrityu
videos.overview: The Sharmas try to cope with Daadi's death in their own ways. Mr Sharma is frustrated when the pandit backs out at the last minute, and Mrs Sharma worries that Daadi's soul is not at peace.

videos.title: Kaun Apna Kaun Paraya
videos.overview: Daadi's death leads to a property dispute in the Sharma family. While his brother is hell-bent on selling the ancestral house, Mr Sharma wants to hold on to it for the memories.

videos.title: Bechaini
videos.overview: Mr Sharma suffers from anxiety and insomnia after Daadi's death. He refuses to take therapy despite the doctor's recommendation. His family tries to help him, but he feels they are treating him like a mental patient.

videos.title: Udaan
videos.overview: Bobby asks Mr Sharma for a loan worth Rs 5 lakh for his food truck. Mr Sharma refuses and instead challenges Bobby to set up a stall at the Diwali fair and earn a substantial amount to prove his worth.

videos.title: Naya Kadam
videos.overview: Mrs Sharma wants to complete her education and gets all the support from Mr Sharma. However, it becomes difficult for her to balance her studies and the responsibilities of the household.

videos.title: Nok Jhok
videos.overview: Sonu and Sarthak are going through tough times. Mr Sharma is unable to figure out why Mrs Sharma is upset. The men watch the India-Pakistan match on Bobby's new TV while the women hang out.

videos.title: Yaadein
videos.overview: The Sharmas have a new dilemma. As they plan for a grand re-marriage party for Mr and Mrs Sharma's 30th anniversary, he hesitates, thinking about the recent death in the family.

videos.title: Tere Mere Sapne
videos.overview: There's more chaos in the Sharma household as Bobby lands himself in debt and the venue for Mr and Mrs Sharma's 30th anniversary gets double-booked. The Sharmas look for a new place, but will they succeed?
